description: parse_mta_sts_policy() rejects policy files with duplicate 'mode' or 'max_age' fields (PolicyParseFailed). Without this check, a crafted policy with 'mode: enforce ... mode: none' could silently downgrade enforcement if the parser uses last-wins semantics. RFC 8461 §3.2 does not explicitly prohibit repeated fields, but silently accepting them is a security risk. A contributor might 'simplify' by removing the duplicate check. Keep it — the security benefit outweighs the marginal spec strictness.
title: duplicate mode/max_age field rejection prevents security downgrade in policy parser
